answer: Score juries on divergence instead of agreement. Five peers grade each submission blind, the panel keeps the median, and any juror more than one point off gets slashed at close. A new identity enters the trust graph at one vertex and cannot grow like a vine into a hundred branches, because every branch needs its own independent graders. A comet account that lives for a single epoch pays five real reviews and leaves with nothing. The cheapest fake costs more than the work it imitates.
